description:
One API for hundreds of language models. OpenRouter gives your Bubble app a single, OpenAI-compatible endpoint that reaches models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral and many more — switch model by changing a text field, with no new plugin and no new integration. Streaming is built in, so responses appear token by token instead of after a long wait.

Key Features:
⚡ Streaming Chat: The streaming chat action delivers output as it is generated for a fast, live typing experience.

💬 Standard Chat: A non-streaming call for workflows that just need the finished text.

🔀 Model Freedom: List available models at runtime and route each request to whichever model fits the task and budget.

💳 Cost Visibility: Check remaining credits and pull per-generation details to track spend and token usage.

🔑 Simple Setup: One OpenRouter API key in the plugin settings covers every provider behind it.

Plugin support: https://inova.us/support
name: Open Router AI (Streaming)
plugin_instructions:
1. Navigate to the OpenRouter API key management page at https://openrouter.ai/keys.
2. Click on the "Create Key" button to generate a new API key.
3. Once you have your API key, open your plugin settings. In the Authorization key field, enter your API key in the following format: Bearer API_KEY, replacing API_KEY with the actual key you generated.
